competitors.title: Security is the biggest concern with all-in-one crypto apps. If one platform fails, everything could
competitors.description:
Security is the biggest concern with all-in-one crypto apps. If one platform fails, everything could be at risk.

That is why @ClappFinance built its custody system with Fireblocks using Multi-Party Computation (MPC) technology.

Instead of relying on a single private key or vulnerable seed phrase, MPC splits key control across multiple secure parties. 

The result:
• Institutional-grade asset protection
• No single point of failure
• A smooth, bank-like user experience

This also aligns with Clapp’s role as a registered EU Virtual Asset Service Provider, ensuring strict compliance while maintaining strong security standards.

2026 Insight:
Crypto is moving beyond the wild west era of DeFi into Regulated DeFi (RegFi), where compliance, security, and usability matter as much as innovation.

By combining regulated infrastructure with features like its 0% credit line, Clapp is positioning itself at the center of crypto security.

The next phase of adoption won’t just be about new tech. It’ll be about trust. 

🔗 https://t.co/9v1lRSSdHz 

#ClappFinance #DeFi #RegFI

Our Treasury team did this with USDC and Circle Mint — replacing fiat wires that take 1-3 days with always-on, near-instant settlement. Full controls. Full auditability. 90% of transfer pricing done in a single day.

This is what the internet financial system looks like in practice. Not theory — operations.

With updates to Circle Mint coming online, this is becoming a possibility for any business.
